units: genre units (Source units), Godot axes; x metres = x * 0.01905

zones.comment: around the map's own `spawn` destination, where it starts a run: players spawn in a dark box (the 66 info_player_counterterrorist) and drop onto a trigger_teleport aimed at `spawn`, the lit start of the course beside the first checkpoint (tele_dest_1). The box is only a way in, so the run starts here
the trigger that plays the ending track, fades the screen and sends the player to the end room (tele_dest_35) 3.5 s later

author: Tony Montana
notes: Credit, and a start and finish read from the map's own `spawn` destination and end trigger (gb-maps-1). The route is 31 checkpoints, tele_dest_1..31, every pit aimed back at the last one. The end: a trigger_multiple at the top of the last climb plays the map's ending track, fades the screen and moves the player to the end room at tele_dest_35 3.5 s later; that trigger is the finish line. Its 32 teleports behind filter_activator are anti-standing blocks (a 0.09 s AddOutput targetname activator on touching a block), so they are sinking blocks here, not pits. Not published.
